catalogue.comment:
COMPLETE LOADOUT + VARIABLE SIZE + ADDITIONAL COPY COST PASS
Tau loadouts follow the fancy-notepad presentation: named Tau model nouns replace generic Model X labels, sergeant titles appear only where there is a distinct sergeant loadout, unmodelled grenade/additive wargear is unit-level, free specialist weapon slots omit ordinary fallback loadouts, Crisis Battlesuits use optional extra-model sizing, and all native non-Rare Other units use Additional Copy Costs.

CONSTRUCTIVE ERROR MIGRATION
T'au now use Game System revision 11. Game System revision 11 supplies current Game Size and Leader Capacity validation. Additional Copy Costs, mandatory Leader attachments, and host Leader limits use constructive player-facing errors. Existing faction semantics remain unchanged; Ethereal continues not to count toward Leader Capacity.

REV4 NEW RECRUIT EXPORT COMPATIBILITY
Updated to Warhammer 40k Reforged Game System revision 12. All Points cost references now use New Recruit's canonical Warhammer 40,000 cost-type identifier 51b2-306e-1021-d207. No unit costs, loadouts, validation, Leader behavior, categories, or Additional Copy Costs arithmetic were otherwise changed.

REV5 POLISH PASS
Standardized player-facing loadout hierarchy by adding explicit model headers to single-model units, removing non-semantic Weapon 1 / Weapon 2 labels from the XV8 Commander and Crisis Battlesuits, flattening Kroot Carnivore and Hunter Pathfinder specialist sections into Loadout Options, renaming the Crisis optional-size group to Additional Model, and presenting XV8 Commander frame upgrades as Battlesuit Configuration rather than Paid Wargear. No points, eligibility, Leader behavior, Additional Copy Costs arithmetic, paid wargear semantics, or underlying weapon-choice logic were otherwise changed.
